description: React component for managing dataset items, including listing, reordering via drag-and-drop, pagination, and dialogs for adding/editing/uploading dataset items.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches dataset rows for the current page and limit.

methods.name: handleDragStart
methods.description: Initiates drag operation, storing start position.

methods.name: handleDragEnd
methods.description: Completes drag operation, reorders dataset rows, and updates via API.

methods.name: onSelectAllClick
methods.description: Selects or deselects all dataset items.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Selects or deselects individual dataset item.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Opens dialog to add new dataset item.

methods.name: uploadCSV
methods.description: Opens dialog to upload CSV file.

methods.name: editDs
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit dataset details.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit a specific dataset item.

methods.name: deleteDatasetItems
methods.description: Deletes selected dataset items after confirmation.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Closes dialogs and refreshes dataset list.
